create_kosmos2_5_config: create a Kosmos2_5Config instance with custom text and vision configuration for the microsoft/kosmos-2.5 model
create_kosmos2_5_text_config: create a Kosmos2_5TextConfig instance with custom embedding dimensions, layers, and attention heads for the text decoder
create_kosmos2_5_vision_config: create a Kosmos2_5VisionConfig instance with custom patch embedding size, layers, and hidden dimensions for the vision encoder
review_kosmos2_5_config_post_init: review the Kosmos2_5Config.__post_init__ method that initializes text_config and vision_config from dicts or defaults
test_kosmos2_5_config_defaults: test that Kosmos2_5Config initializes text_config and vision_config with default values when None is passed
